name: Snow White
description: In the depth of winter, a queen wishes for a child as white as snow, as red as blood, and with hair as black as ebony. After her mother's death, little Snow-white grows beneath the envy of a stepmother who questions her looking-glass and has her taken into the forest. Sheltered by seven dwarfs and struck down at last by a poisoned apple, she lies in a glass coffin until her bearers stumble and free the fatal morsel. At the wedding, the Queen receives the reward of her cruelty.

legal.license: Based on Little Snow-White (KHM 53) by the Brothers Grimm. Description adapted from Margaret Hunt's 1884 public-domain translation.
